name: luna-companion
description: Build, test and run an isolated Luna runtime; inspect logs, JVM diagnostics and extensible game-state collectors.

interface.longDescription: Run builds and tests in the isolated Luna clone, manage a session-owned runtime, inspect bounded logs, JVM health and threads, and query extensible game-state collectors. Requires Python 3 and JDK 21.
interface.defaultPrompt: Build and test Luna in the agent clone, then inspect runtime health and game state.
